newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-DRAW FOR WORLD MATCHPLAY GOLF.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-DRAW FOR WORLD MATCHPLAY GOLF.

text.p: The draw for the World Matchplay golf championship beginning at Wentworth on Thursday was made on Monday.
The draw for the 36-hole matches is (prefix numbers denote seeding):
Winner to play 1-Ernie Els (South Africa) in Friday's second round Ian Woosnam (Britain) v 5-Colin Montgomerie (Britain)
Winner to play 4-Mark Brooks (U.S.) in second round 6-Phil Mickelson (U.S.) v Vijay Singh (Fiji)
Winner to play 3-Steve Jones (U.S.) in second round Nobuo Serizawa (Japan) v 7-Mark O'Meara (U.S.)
Winner to play 2-Tom Lehman (U.S.) in second round.
